name: MOTIS (staging)
description: Staging MOTIS instance — rebuild target for the data-manager's Transitous atomic-swap pipeline. Not query-facing; only the primary `motis` service receives application traffic. Opt-in: start with `--services motis-staging` (or add to the persisted selection) when running the data-manager promotion flow.

container.user: ${UID:?UID must be set, run pnpm openmapx compose render}:${GID:?GID must be set, run pnpm openmapx compose render}
command: until [ -f /motis-data/config.yml ]; do echo 'motis-staging: waiting for /motis-data/config.yml'; sleep 5; done; /motis import && /motis server || { echo 'motis-staging: import/serve failed; holding (a pipeline restart will retry)'; while true; do sleep 3600; done; }

OPENMAPX_MEMORY_MIB.title: Container memory limit (MiB)
OPENMAPX_MEMORY_MIB.description: Configure this resource on primary MOTIS. One generation applies the same limit to both slots and the transit preflight capacity envelope.

OPENMAPX_CPU_LIMIT.title: Container CPU limit
OPENMAPX_CPU_LIMIT.description: Configure this resource on primary MOTIS. One generation applies the same limit to both slots and the transit preflight capacity envelope.
